macros.name: collectverb
macros.doc: Collects verbatim text which can be typeset.

macros.name: Collectverb
macros.doc: Collects argument as plain verbatim and feeds it to the given code.

macros.name: collectverbenv
macros.doc: Collects verbatim text which can be typeset.

macros.name: Collectverbenv
macros.doc: Collects environment content as plain verbatim and feeds it to the given code.

macros.name: newverbcommand
macros.doc: This macros allow the definition of \verb variants.

macros.name: newverbsfont
macros.doc: Macro which activates the font used by the newverbs package for the verbatim text.

macros.name: provideverbcommand
macros.doc: This macros allow the definition of \verb variants.

macros.name: qverb
macros.doc: Places a quote character before and after the verbatim content: “verb”.

macros.name: qverbbeginquote
macros.doc: This macros insert the actual quotes.

macros.name: qverbendquote
macros.doc: Two macros are used to insert the quotes: \qverbbeginquote (“) and \qverbendquote (”).

macros.name: verbdef
macros.doc: This macro defines the 〈\macro〉 as a robust macro which typesets the 〈verbatim material〉 in the usual verbatim font.

macros.name: Verbdef
macros.doc: This macro uses \Collectverb internally to define 〈\macro〉 as the plain 〈verbatim material〉.
